bull.b: Sustained high growth indicates expanding adoption of the OCS platform and related services. Guidance excludes meaningful PAD, ENHANCE Part B and DENOVO contributions, leaving potential upside from future program maturation.

Increasing service revenue alongside product sales supports a utilization-based model with recurring case-related economics. Higher transplant activity can deepen customer integration and expand revenue per installed OCS system over time.

A substantial cash position provides funding for OCS Kidney, Gen 3.0, clinical programs and international logistics expansion without immediate reliance on external capital. This supports continued investment while preserving strategic flexibility.

bear.b: Higher leverage reduces financial flexibility and increases sensitivity to operating setbacks. With interest expense expected near $29M for the year, debt-related costs could constrain investment capacity if profitability weakens further.

Weaker free-cash-flow conversion suggests that growth currently requires substantial reinvestment or working capital. Margin compression could limit the company’s ability to convert rapid revenue expansion into durable earnings and internally funded growth.

The growth roadmap depends on multiple clinical, regulatory and international initiatives advancing successfully. PAD integration and pending approvals may increase costs before contributing revenue, creating a prolonged period of execution and profitability risk.
